findings.title: Remote Code Execution on Windows Client Nodes via PowerShell Subexpression Injection in winotify Toast Notifications
findings.description: Audio title (name) from uploaded audio or WebSocket play_audio events is passed into winotify.Notification(title, msg), which interpolates msg inside a PowerShell double-quoted here-string (@"..."@) and executes powershell.exe -Command. Any $(...) subexpression in the audio title executes arbitrary PowerShell commands on targeted Windows client nodes.
findings.remediation: Strip or escape $, `, ", and newlines from title and msg in receiver.py:notify_toast before passing to winotify.Notification.

findings.title: Arbitrary File Write via Path Traversal in Audio Upload and Client Media Sync
findings.description: upload_audio joins AUDIO_DIR / file.filename without Path(file.filename).name sanitization, allowing ../ traversal or absolute path overwrites as root inside the privileged container, and propagates unsanitized filenames to Windows client nodes during media sync.
findings.remediation: Sanitize filenames using Path(filename).name on both backend upload_audio and Windows client _download_media_file / sync_schedules_and_media.

findings.title: Dangerous Fail-Open Broadcast Logic in /api/play Blasts All Physical Harbor Speakers When Target Speaker/Group Is Missing or Disabled
findings.description: When target_mode is 'speaker' or 'group' and the specified speaker_id/group_id is disabled (enabled=0) or does not exist, matching_dict is empty and /api/play falls back to else: is_all_mode = True, blasting audio across all 12 physical outdoor harbor horn speakers and multicast.
findings.remediation: Raise HTTPException(status_code=404) when target_mode != 'all' and matching_dict is empty, matching scheduler.py behavior.

findings.title: Complete Absence of Authentication & Permissive CORS (allow_origins=['*']) Across Administrative, Broadcast, and Node Control APIs
findings.description: All REST and WebSocket endpoints lack authentication and allow wildcard CORS origins, enabling any LAN peer or malicious webpage visited by an operator to trigger emergency sirens, delete audio files, or hijack node IP registrations.
findings.remediation: Restrict CORS allow_origins to explicit server URLs and add token/PIN authentication for administrative and node endpoints.

findings.title: FFmpeg tee Muxer Slave Option & Arbitrary File Write Injection via Unvalidated Speaker ip_address
findings.description: Speaker ip_address is not validated as an IP address and is interpolated into FFmpeg's tee muxer string separated by '|', allowing injection of additional tee slave outputs (such as local file writes) during multi-speaker RTP playback.
findings.remediation: Validate ip_address fields using Python's ipaddress.ip_address() in Pydantic models or endpoint handlers.
